paragraphs.text: Sphere is a nonbasic land type used for cards that depict the Spheres of New Phyrexia .

Spheres were introduced in Phyrexia: All Will Be One . There are exactly nine cards with the Sphere typeline, corresponding with the Spheres of New Phyrexia. Five of these form a colored cycle at common. The remaining four were then designed top down and put at rare.
Monument to Perfection can search for a Sphere card. It is the only card that cares about the subtype Sphere. Ezuri, Stalker of Spheres , from the same set, doesn't interact with Spheres.
Planar Nexus has the subtype due to its ability to have all non-basic land types, but it is not written on its typeline.
Artifacts or Enchantments named Sphere (e.g. Commander's Sphere , Capture Sphere ) can't have the Sphere type.
